other_conditions: Children for the Chief Minister Child Service Scheme (General) are eligible
Eligibility is limited to orphan children and offspring of duly registered construction workers who have completed at least one year (365 days) membership period of the board after registration
A maximum of two children per registered worker can avail educational benefits
Children must be identified by the Women Welfare Department, Lucknow
Eligibility category noted in source: children destitute during the Corona period
Eligibility category noted in source: orphan children
Eligibility category noted in source: children of duly registered construction workers
benefits_summary: Free residential education, accommodation, meals, medical facilities and sports/recreational activities for eligible children.
